intro: The Warsong Scout Update is a written dispatch containing battlefield reconnaissance from Splintertree Post in Ashenvale. Gathered by a forward scout of the Warsong clan, it provides commander Kadrak with critical intelligence needed to secure the Horde's foothold against night elf resistance.

p: As the Horde attempts to claim timber and establish supply routes through Ashenvale, scouts from the Warsong clan patrol deep behind enemy lines. The Warsong Scout Update compiles local observations from the fortified encampment of Splintertree Post, tracking night elf sentinels and territorial movements. Handed over to messengers trading routine orders, the document allows Kadrak at the Barrens-Ashenvale border to assess troop readiness and coordinate logistics in the contested woods.
